It indicates that the visual features defining a 'barometer' (specifically the legible scale and context) are so degraded by artifacts that the object loses its semantic identity. The Router underestimated the impact of this semantic drift. The `perceptual_quality_auditor` only found slight compression, missing the structural implication of the text failure. I am upgrading the severity of the overall artifact impact because the text failure destroys the object's function.
